text: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: The aim of this major is to cultivate students with the basic application of Chinese Language. In the regular Chinese program, winter semester usually starts at the beginning of September and ends at the beginning of January, while summer semester usually from early March to late June. 2. Courses Structure Editor Notes: There are 16 teaching weeks in each semester, with 20+ class hours (Chinese classes plus selective courses) each week. Students will have Chinese classes in the morning from Monday to Friday, and the selective courses in the afternoon. Selective courses usually include China economy lectures and various cultural classes according to students' needs. 3. Textbooks New Practical Chinese Reader , Chinese Tutorial and Developing Chinese (published by Beijing Language and Culture University) are mainly used as textbooks, together with supportive textbooks like General Information of China and Elementary Business Chinese Dialogue as well as the University's own teaching materials. 4. Fees Application Fee: RMB 400 Textbooks and Materials (in RMB): About 150 to 300 per semester 5. School Introduction Editor Notes: It is one of the top 100 universities in the nation's 211 Project, a national initiative to build 100 first-class universities in the 21st century. The University , boasts a strong faculty of scholarly excellence and professional dedication. Added to this is the classic campus setting, situated in Chengdu, a beautiful city of fine culture and long history plus being in the vicinity of Du Fu Thatched Cottage, residence of a prominent poet in Tang Dynasty , Learn More>> 6. The College of International Education Editor Notes: The College of International Education of SWUFE was established in 2004. ​ It is the combination of the former Foreign Students Education Center and the SWUFE Training Center for Personnel Working/Studying Abroad. There are above 20 full and part time professors and teachers, many of whom have experience teaching in foreign countries in Asia, Europe, America and Africa. The highly-qualified faculty is among the top in western China. 7. Campus Life Editor Notes: International students enjoy the wonderful life in the campus. Recreational Activities Internship
